verdicts.reason: A reads left to right as a banner should, but the 'Cascadia' wordmark is larger than the 'New pasta menu' headline, which reverses the hierarchy. The two food photos are shrunk to unreadable thumbnails, 'RESTAURANT' sits far away from 'Cascadia', and loose fragments of the frame's brush strokes float across the strip. B is worse: the headline is a tiny three-line stack jammed into the middle above 'Cascadia', and the website is a speck pushed into the top-left corner. Its photos are also postage-stamp size, 'RESTAURANT' drifts off on its own at the right, and leftover background illustration fragments clutter the left side, so there is no clear reading order.
